_comment: Runtime settings, written by the dashboard's Settings panel. config.json is gitignored and this file documents its shape. You do not need to create it: it is written the first time you change something in the dashboard, and everything below is the default until then.
_toggles: Passed through to the pipeline. createLinearIssue: draft a Linear ticket once the verdict is in and create it only after you say yes. botReview: after the PR opens, wait for the review bots on the head commit, then run /resolve. saveToMemory: let a run PROPOSE a memory into data/runs/memories/, never write one; recurrence or your approval promotes it. reply: draft the verdict for the Slack thread and post it once you approve.
_followup: The defaults a new chat's job options start from. A chat overrides any of them from its composer, and its picks live on the run rather than here. An empty workdir falls back to TARGET_REPO in .env.
